# Split
train = cleaned[cleaned['split']=='train']
test = cleaned[cleaned['split']=='test']

y_test = test['target'].values

    'y_true': y_test,
    'y_pred': y_pred,
    'y_score': y_score,
    'accuracy': acc,
    'precision': prec,
    'recall': rec,
    'f1': f1,
